title: Social builds against a pinned copy of the reader's SurfaceHost contract and a fake host typed from it

tasks.title: Pin the reader's contract, runtime schemas and the pin check
Fake host typed from the pinned contract

acs.text: WHEN a value arrives from the host (the host object itself, a location, a viewer, a ctx value, a reader snapshot) THE SYSTEM SHALL validate it with a runtime schema whose output type is proven equal to the pinned contract's type at compile time, refusing another contract major, a snapshot that carries `ctx` or points off-site, and malformed values.
scenarios: Values from the host are validated against the pinned contract

acs.text: WHEN a test or the harness uses the fake host THE SYSTEM SHALL behave like the reader where the surface can observe it: a browser-like history (push, replace, back, forward, notifications), refusal and report of off-site navigation, `ctx` exposed only when well-formed with change-only notifications, `applySnapshot` that validates and keeps the current `ctx`, a short-lived token signed with a test key for a signed-in viewer and `SignedOutError` otherwise, and a recorded sign-in request.
scenarios: The fake host behaves like the reader

acs.text: WHEN a pinned contract file differs from the hash recorded when it was pinned from a reader commit THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the pinned-contract check with a message naming the file and how to fix it.
scenarios: A hand edit of the pinned contract fails the pin check

acs.text: WHEN the pinned contract removes or renames a member THE SYSTEM SHALL fail to compile the fake host.
scenarios: A renamed contract member stops the fake host compiling
